movie.title: Doctor Glas
movie.overview: The lonely doctor Gabriel Glas despises society's superficiality - until the fashion designer Helga enters his life. She's trapped in a destructive marriage, and Gabriel sees his chance to save her. Soon, they are caught in a web of lies, desire, and power. The deeper Gabriel is drawn into the relationship, the more moral boundaries he crosses - with catastrophic consequences.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In modern Stockholm, lonely physician Gabriel Glas becomes obsessed with saving fashion designer Helga from her toxic marriage, drawing them both into a perilous web of lie-driven passion and tragic moral decay.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Doctor Gabriel Glas leads an isolated life, harboring deep contempt for the superficiality of high society. Everything shifts when he meets Helga, a stylish fashion designer trapped in a deeply destructive, coercive marriage. Eager to liberate her, Gabriel offers his aid, but their initial connection quickly spirals into an intense obsession marked by desire and deceit. As Gabriel willingly crosses ethical and legal boundaries to rescue Helga, his descent into dark obsession leads to catastrophic, life-altering consequences.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Disillusioned physician Gabriel Glas lives a solitary existence in Stockholm, privately scorning the hollow conventions and hypocrisy of modern society. His detachment from humanity is suddenly shattered when Helga, a brilliant fashion designer, seeks his medical advice regarding her emotionally abusive marriage. Seeing her profound distress, Gabriel instantly fixates on Helga, perceiving his intervention as a grand personal calling to save her from her cruel spouse. What starts as professional sympathy rapidly evolves into a clandestine, risk-laden affair fueled by mutual longing and deceit. Helga relies heavily on Gabriel's mounting influence, while Gabriel becomes intoxicated by the power he exerts over her life and destiny. As their web of lies tightens around them, Gabriel finds himself abandoning his professional ethics and personal integrity piece by piece. His rationalizations deepen as he considers extreme measures to permanently free Helga from her husband's grasp. Ultimately, Gabriel's relentless pursuit of salvation drives him past the point of moral no return, triggering a devastating chain of events that shatters both of their lives.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Doctor Gabriel Glas is a solitary and deeply cynical physician who views society's polite facades with quiet disdain. His controlled, isolated world is upended when fashion designer Helga enters his clinic, desperate for escape from a controlling and destructive marriage. Captivated by her predicament, Gabriel agrees to help her, sparking a complex relationship defined by forbidden longing, psychological manipulation, and power dynamics. As Gabriel becomes increasingly entangled in Helga's domestic plight, he is forced to confront the limits of his own morality, embarking on a dangerous trajectory where good intentions yield disastrous results.

story_structure.climax: Driven by his obsession and desperate to save Helga, Gabriel makes a drastic, irrevocable choice that crosses the ultimate moral threshold.
story_structure.conflict: Helga enters his life and reveals she is trapped in a deeply destructive, unfulfilling marriage, sparking Gabriel's obsession to intervene and free her.
story_structure.resolution: Gabriel faces the profound personal and psychological aftermath of his actions, left to endure the inescapable weight of the path he chose.
story_structure.introduction: Doctor Gabriel Glas leads an isolated existence, disillusioned by societal norms and superficiality, while harboring a deep personal boredom and existential detachment.
story_structure.risingAction: Gabriel becomes entangled in Helga's secrets, navigating a complex web of desire and manipulation as his willingness to compromise his ethics deepens.
